name: MedicalRecord
description: Stores a patient's medical record entry or visit summary, potentially including diagnoses, treatments, and notes.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Owning user (patient) — set automatically on create from the authenticated user; only the owning patient or an admin/doctor may read or update their medical record.

attributes.name: patientId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Patient entity this record belongs to.

attributes.name: doctorId
attributes.description: Foreign key to the Doctor entity who authored or reviewed this record.

attributes.name: recordDate
attributes.description: The date the medical record entry was created or updated.

attributes.name: recordType
attributes.description: The type of medical record entry (e.g., diagnosis, treatment, note).

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The detailed content of the medical record entry.

attributes.name: treatmentPlan
attributes.description: Details of the treatment plan prescribed.
